title: How names rise and fall
text: name sex sector, curve name’s share listed babies sector sex year, averaged 5 years (centered; first last years repeated ends), divided maximum, every curve peaks 1. names given 50 babies top year used. “Half peak” 0.5 curve.
code: years <- min(babynamesIL$year):max(babynamesIL$year) min_top <- 50 edge <- 3 # a peak in the first or last 3 years is not taken as an inner peak  smooth5 <- function(v) {     n <- length(v)     idx <- pmin(pmax(outer(seq_len(n), -2:2, `+`), 1), n)     rowMeans(matrix(v[idx], n)) }  shares <- babynamesIL %>%     group_by(sector, sex, year) %>%     mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>%     ungroup() %>%     select(sector, sex, name, year, n, share) %>%     complete(nesting(sector, sex, name), year = years, fill = list(n = 0, share = 0))  curves <- shares %>%     group_by(sector, sex, name) %>%     filter(max(n) >= min_top) %>%     arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%     summarise(top = max(n), x = list(smooth5(share) / max(smooth5(share))), .groups = "drop") count(curves, sector) #> # A tibble: 4 × 2 #>   sector             n #>   <chr>          <int> #> 1 Christian-Arab     6 #> 2 Druze              8 #> 3 Jewish           937 #> 4 Muslim           424

text: name gets one shape, rules, order: Comeback camel (two waves): curve dip (away first last 5 years) half lower highs two sides, lower high least quarter peak. comeback first year already half first high (name rise within data), otherwise camel. curve several dips, deepest one (relative lower high) counts. Stable: never third peak. Still rising: peak last 3 years. Declining since 1949: peak first 3 years. Bell: rest, one peak inside years. span name measured curve. Rise: years first year half peak peak. Fall: years peak last year half peak. measured peak least 3 years inside data side crosses half inside , names cut first last year pull numbers . Every name one row, grouped shape ordered peak year. diagonal “bell” procession fashions: name turn, turns short.   biggest names four less common shapes: sit edge rule. name low sizable level 1949 one big rise later can count comeback (בן, ניקול), one-year spike can make second high (שמחה, 1990s). Muslim sector early years listed babies (3203 1949), early dips (ג’יהאד, פארס) may noise, several Muslim camel curves jagged.
code: shape_levels <- c("bell", "still rising", "declining since 1949", "stable", "comeback", "camel")  deepest_dip <- function(x) {     n <- length(x)     pre <- cummax(x)     post <- rev(cummax(rev(x)))     m <- 6:(n - 5)     lo <- pmin(pre[m - 1], post[m + 1])     ok <- lo >= 1 / 4     if (!any(ok)) {         return(NULL)     }     r <- ifelse(ok, x[m] / pmax(lo, 1e-12), Inf)     low <- m[which.min(r)]     list(depth = min(r), low = low, high1 = which.max(x[1:(low - 1)]), high2 = low + which.max(x[(low + 1):n])) }  shape_of <- function(x) {     n <- length(x)     p <- which.max(x)     d <- deepest_dip(x)     if (!is.null(d) && d$depth < 1 / 2) {         return(if (x[1] >= x[d$high1] / 2) "comeback" else "camel")     }     if (min(x) >= 1 / 3) {         return("stable")     }     if (p > n - edge) {         return("still rising")     }     if (p <= edge) {         return("declining since 1949")     }     "bell" }  spans_of <- function(x) {     n <- length(x)     p <- which.max(x)     l <- p     r <- p     while (l > 1 && x[l - 1] >= 0.5) l <- l - 1     while (r < n && x[r + 1] >= 0.5) r <- r + 1     inner <- p > edge && p <= n - edge     tibble(         peak = years[p], from = years[l], to = years[r],         rise = if (inner && l > 1) p - l else NA_integer_,         fall = if (inner && r < n) r - p else NA_integer_     ) }  dyn <- curves %>%     mutate(shape = factor(map_chr(x, shape_of), levels = shape_levels), sp = map(x, spans_of)) %>%     unnest(sp)  dyn %>%     count(sector, shape) %>%     pivot_wider(names_from = sector, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%     knitr::kable() heat_plot <- function(s) {     dyn %>%         filter(sector == s) %>%         arrange(shape, peak, name) %>%         group_by(shape) %>%         mutate(row = row_number()) %>%         ungroup() %>%         mutate(year = list(years)) %>%         select(shape, row, x, year) %>%         unnest(c(x, year)) %>%         ggplot(aes(year, row, fill = x)) +         geom_raster() +         scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkblue", limits = c(0, 1), name = "share of\nits peak") +         scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0, 0)) +         scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +         facet_grid(shape ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +         labs(x = "year of birth", y = NULL, title = sprintf("%s  n = %d", s, sum(dyn$sector == s))) +         theme(             axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),             strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 7, margin = margin(0, 3, 0, 3)), panel.spacing.y = unit(2, "pt")         ) } heat_plot("Jewish") heat_plot("Muslim") dyn %>%     filter(sector %in% c("Jewish", "Muslim"), shape %in% c("stable", "comeback", "camel", "still rising")) %>%     group_by(sector, shape) %>%     slice_max(top, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%     summarise(names = paste(name, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%     knitr::kable()

code: med <- function(v) {     v <- v[!is.na(v)]     if (length(v) < 20) {         return("too few names")     }     sprintf("%s (%s-%s), n=%d", format(median(v)), round(quantile(v, 0.25)), round(quantile(v, 0.75)), length(v)) } dyn %>%     group_by(sector) %>%     summarise(         span = med(if_else(!is.na(rise) & !is.na(fall), rise + fall + 1L, NA_integer_)),         rise = med(rise), fall = med(fall)     ) %>%     relocate(span, .after = fall) %>%     knitr::kable(caption = "Median years (middle half of the names), and the number of names measured. Span: years at or above half the peak, for names with both sides measured.") both %>%     filter(sector %in% c("Jewish", "Muslim")) %>%     group_by(sector) %>%     summarise(         names = n(), fall_slower = mean(fall > rise), fall_faster = mean(fall < rise),         spearman_rho = cor(rise, fall, method = "spearman")     ) %>%     knitr::kable(digits = 2) dyn %>%     filter(sector %in% c("Jewish", "Muslim")) %>%     pivot_longer(c(rise, fall), names_to = "side", values_to = "years_") %>%     filter(!is.na(years_)) %>%     mutate(side = factor(side, c("rise", "fall"), c("rise: half the peak to the peak", "fall: the peak to half"))) %>%     ggplot(aes(years_, color = sector)) +     stat_ecdf(geom = "step") +     scale_color_manual(values = c(Jewish = "black", Muslim = "coral3")) +     facet_wrap(~side) +     coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 45)) +     labs(x = "years", y = "fraction of names") aligned <- dyn %>%     filter(sector %in% c("Jewish", "Muslim"), shape == "bell") %>%     mutate(p = peak - min(years) + 1) %>%     select(sector, name, sex, p, x) %>%     crossing(offset = -40:40) %>%     mutate(i = p + offset) %>%     filter(i >= 1, i <= length(years)) %>%     mutate(v = map2_dbl(x, i, ~ .x[.y])) %>%     group_by(sector, offset) %>%     filter(n() >= 30) %>%     summarise(         q10 = quantile(v, 0.1), q25 = quantile(v, 0.25), q50 = median(v),         q75 = quantile(v, 0.75), q90 = quantile(v, 0.9), .groups = "drop"     )  ggplot(aligned, aes(offset)) +     geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q10, ymax = q90), fill = "gray85") +     geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), fill = "gray65") +     geom_line(aes(y = q50)) +     geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted") +     facet_wrap(~sector) +     labs(x = "years from the peak", y = "share of its peak")

what: Bug Fix: Incorrect totals in babynamesIL_totals
title: babynamesIL 0.2.3
text: release fixes significant data bug introduced v0.2.0. v0.2.0, babynamesIL_totals dataset inadvertently changed compute totals summing filtered yearly data (includes years name given ≥5 babies). resulted substantially underreported totals, especially less common names. CBS source data includes accurate “total” column counts registrations across years, including years 5-baby threshold. release restores use CBS total column. Impact: Names uncommon (rarely reaching ≥5/year) affected. example, “אביעזר” reported 5 (1 year crossed threshold) true CBS total 129. Even common names like “דוד” slightly underreported (95,744 vs correct 97,218).
